report.summary:
Independent frozen-manifest audit of Build R1 (evidence assembly) for TradingAgents, range 730bbe04 (confirmed R5 staging, seven green CI jobs) → f7fec67e (frozen head), 71 changed files. Stage: local feature candidate, unpushed; this run is the required independent Claude Fable review after two provider-402 failures (both preserved, zero findings, no verdict; retry explicitly user-approved under unchanged $50/$80, 100/160-turn caps).

VERDICTS — Merge integrity: PASS on the frozen range: the diff is coherent, confined to R1-owned files plus its fixtures/tests/review artifacts and the plan-status/checkbox updates; checkpoint identity is correctly advanced (shared_source_brief 4→5 in trading_graph.py with the extended version-separation regression), and the historical Build2 drill freezes only R1's new optional sensitivity output while explicitly denying current-resume compatibility. Feature acceptance: PASS on frozen evidence — every material requirement traces to implementation and a named test (coverage below), the wired source proof reports the plan's defining outcomes (ATM in brief; 15 accepted/0 rejected deterministic acquisition and gate records; six valid/three originally-rejected model records with identical original reasons; FY2026 outlook blocks 39–52 intact at 36,000 chars; RPO history and labeled maturity line in brief and canonical context; dated/degraded news; finance_equipment 70.52/all_leases 65.31 vs base 77.73 and cautious 37.88/32.98 on unchanged base targets); acceptance rests partly on hashed builder receipts since this runner cannot execute. Full-suite health: GREEN PER BUILDER RECEIPT (3448 passed/10 skipped/1 deselected/100 subtests at 87845f5a; the two earlier 1-fail runs are correctly treated as historical, each diagnosed as fixture/version-expectation conflicts, not aggregated); independently UNVERIFIED. Remote CI: UNVERIFIED/NOT YET APPLICABLE — no run exists for any R1 candidate; only the predecessor baseline 730bbe04 has the green exact-SHA receipt.

REQUIREMENT COVERAGE — R1.1 financing in brief: implemented by rebinding the deterministic issuer_events matcher (extended to dated notes/credit-agreement quotes, fail-closed on undated/future text) into build_shared_source_brief; tests test_brief_includes_retained_atm_8k / test_brief_omits_financing_outside_window / test_brief_reuses_source_matcher_for_notes_and_credit_events; financing_sensitivities now excludes non-ATM types. COVERED. R1.2 guidance runs: extract_sections groups heading-delimited outlook/guidance runs as atomic selection units with max-of-block priorities, whole-drop plus one named gap; tests incl. adjacent-headings case. COVERED. R1.3 identity dedupe: new collapse_quote_packages merges immutable views by full identity tuple, rejects hash/identity/block/inline-fact conflicts with 'conflicting document metadata', preserves source order, fail-closed to REVIEW at the gate; the second root cause (complete qualified sentences lacking a numeric sub-span) is fixed by reusing the existing finite qualified-span/lower-bound matchers without rewriting submissions; 6-accepted/3-still-rejected proved on the recorded corpus. COVERED. R1.4/G7: new retained_kpi_context renders RPO year-ago/FY/current/prior/next-12-months with per-piece source IDs, strict note-unit and reporting-currency checks, recast label, and the undiscounted/present-value maturity line with total+interest=PV consistency check; 10-K-primary post-freeze correction included with its red log; extensive fail-closed negatives. COVERED. R1.5: UTC publish timestamps, explicit 'Publication time unavailable', degraded search-fallback coverage propagated through news_tool_coverage. COVERED. R1.6: warning dedupe preserving checks; model-rejection vs source-gap split plus named missing optional detail; `$`→USD only on same-accession XBRL/stated-currency binding with conflict staying unresolved; priceHint-bounded display precision that cannot zero a subunit price (post-freeze correction, red logs retained). COVERED. R1.7: diagnosis-first (empty sensitivities traced to borrowings-only submissions, recorded in baseline JSON before code), then _source_bound_lease_requests reuses price_case on separately labelled requests, preserves original request/base target (asserted in tests), holds 2026-09-30 balances constant through 2027-12-31 with explicit assumption text, withholds on ambiguity/currency/date/basis incompatibility (parameterized negatives). COVERED. G2 bands: 252-completed-session window kept separate from observed closes (missing-close disclosure, no stale substitution), exact Decimal bounds with distinct sub-unit labels, cutoff-safe, retained-DOCN-source end-to-end test matching the plan's exact March values. COVERED. G4: 15/0 acceptance of the 16416b7e corpus with the five required guided records and order-independence; corpus-differences JSON records the bounded-view block variance (42/43/47/49) as the reproduced retention defect. COVERED. G5: ambiguity drop only for non-consumed metrics in peer packages with recorded gap surfaced in the reference brief; Revenue/Gross Profit/Shares and subject packages still strict; NBIS exclusion now names consumed Revenues@2023-12-31. COVERED.

FINDINGS — No blocking finding. No proven Critical/High/Medium defect was identified in the frozen scope; three low, non-blocking observations are listed (one robustness guard, one label wording, one spec-compliant disclosure gap). Global constraints hold on inspection: no rating-eligibility/gate-rule change except the specified identity-dedupe and message changes; fail-closed behavior preserved or strengthened at every changed boundary; source IDs retained on every new model input; no new vendor calls. The reconciled contradictions (two historical full-suite failures vs the final green receipt; two failed audit attempts vs this one; pre-freeze vs post-freeze corrections with red/green logs) are all consistently documented and none converts into a source defect. R1 remains a local verified feature candidate: staging integration/push, exact-SHA remote CI, Sequence 6–7 paid baselines, and all later builds remain separately gated and incomplete.
limitations: Frozen-evidence-only executor: no test execution, no network, no GitHub queries, no repository reads outside the single frozen request.json. The 3448-pass full suite, full-repo Ruff, source proof and 4-attempt CLI proof at 87845f5a5a are hashed builder receipts (logs identified by SHA-256 in the verification JSON), accepted as builder evidence, not independently rerun; full-suite-health is therefore green-per-receipt, independently unverified.

The frozen head f7fec67e differs from the tested/proof commit 87845f5a only by docs/evidence commits according to builder-recorded Git tree/blob OIDs; frozen evidence cannot independently verify Git ancestry or tree equality, so the claim that head source equals the tested source is builder-asserted, with the frozen head diff itself as the audited source of truth.

No remote CI run exists for any R1 candidate SHA (branch is local and unpushed by design); the green seven-job CI receipt applies only to the predecessor staging baseline 730bbe04. A local unpushed candidate cannot receive a green remote-CI verdict.

Gzipped fixture bytes (corpora, SEC wrappers, OHLCV CSV) were audited via manifest hashes, recorded block counts, the corpus-differences inventory and the 29 bounded verbatim source excerpts; no independent decompression or byte-level inspection was performed.

Private originals (cfae95e9 full state, OHLCV cache), /tmp proof logs, and the two failed external Fable run artifact directories are referenced by hash/path only and were not read, per the frozen-manifest constraint.

Scope is extra large (71 files, ~350KB diff over a 1.48MB requirements payload); production code and all named tests were read in full, but binary fixtures and some long doc-review JSON bodies were sampled rather than exhaustively read.

This audit covers R1 local feature acceptance only; staging integration/push, Sequence 6–7 paid baseline runs, dependent builds R2–R4/R3/Na/Nb, and any release remain separately gated and incomplete by design.

findings.title: build_shared_source_brief validates filing_evidence without a local exception guard: issuer_supplement() runs DisclosurePackage.model_validate(state['filing_evidence']) inside the brief builder with no surrounding try/except, so a malformed (non-None) filing_evidence dict would raise ValidationError out of the brief instead of degrading to a brief without financing lines. Reachability requires corrupted self-produced state and was not reproduced; existing neighbors (financing_sensitivities) catch ValueError for the same call. Corrective direction: wrap the financing block in the same (ValueError, TypeError) guard used elsewhere in the brief; verification: a unit test feeding a malformed filing_evidence through build_shared_source_brief.

get_global_news_yfinance unconditionally labels results 'degraded: search_fallback, headlines_only' although Yahoo search is its only/primary acquisition path, not a fallback; the reason string slightly misstates the mechanism for global news (headlines_only and sample-coverage are accurate; 'search_fallback' is not). Honest-labeling intent is met and ticker-news labeling is exactly per spec (R1.5); display/coverage wording only, no gate effect. Corrective direction: a distinct reason string (e.g. 'search_sample, headlines_only') for the global path with its one-line test; non-blocking.

Prior-close band table silently omits closes above the latest completed close: bands run only from the latest close down to the lowest (as the approved G2 spec literally defines), so an in-window higher close appears in no band and no row or note discloses that, while the header says counts cover the completed-session window. test_band_table_respects_cutoff encodes this as intended (80.00 absent). Spec-compliant, so not a defect; flagged because a reader may infer no higher prior trading existed. Corrective direction (optional requirement, needs plan owner decision): one disclosure line counting closes above the latest close.
